messages:
alex: Heads-up — release-notes CI flagged a tokenization/logit diff for orca-mini-8b-q when runtime v3.2 kernel selection kicked in. Observed ~0.8% top-1 rerank delta on the production prompt set.

marta: link to the report?

alex: https://ci.internal/reports/3412349999/token-diff.html (CI artifact). TL;DR: kernel selector preferred nv_fused for seq_len < 128 which changes accumulation order on a quant build; small but consistent shift in logits.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: unpin-request (runtime:v3.1 -> v3.2) canary window 03:00-04:00 UTC. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3412349999`.

cheng: Did we cross any safety thresholds? global is 0.8% but some customer routes show 2.6% drop.

lina: ops suggestion: gate the unpin by quantization. Keep runtime pinned for *-q variants until we have kernel shim validated. Staged unpin: non-q first.

alex: Proposed plan: 
1) Abort global unpin for now.
2) Apply a pinlist override for quantized models (model_group '*-q', runtime <=v3.1).
3) Run a 4h driftwatch and targeted canaries on non-quant buckets.
4) Ship kernel shim or fallback selector for quant builds, then revisit.

marta: +1. Also update release notes: "Deferred runtime v3.2 for quantized model variants pending kernel shim to preserve logits stability."

cheng: Rollback play if telemetry degrades: 
1) Deploybot rollback flag -> soft-route traffic back to v3.1 pools.
2) Apply emergency pinlist entry.
3) Open a short incident with postmortem template.
Example commands:

```
# To create an emergency pinlist rule (dry-run):
deploybot pinlist add --model-match '*-q' --runtime '<=3.1' --reason 'token-diff regression' --expires '72h'
# To apply saved template:
deploybot pinlist apply pin-341235
```

deploybot: ack: pinlist rule template saved (id: pin-341235). To apply run: `deploybot pinlist apply pin-341235`.

lina: I will run a regression eval on a 10k prompt subset (quant vs non-quant) — ETA ~90m. Posting interim results to this thread.

alex: thanks. I'll update the release notes draft and loop in product. If driftwatch stays within +/-0.2% we can proceed with non-quant canary.

opsbot: monitor rule registered: page eng-oncall if rerank_top1_drop > 1.5% on any customer route.

marta: tagging @pm-ml and @release here for visibility. We'll hold the public changelog line until we have shim + verification. :thumbsup:
